title.narrative: The World Bank/European Investment Bank (EIB) Carbon Fund for Europe

description.narrative: "CFE would be established, administered and managed by the IBRD. The European Investment Bank (""EIB"") would work with the IBRD in order to fulfill its objectives. IBRD would be managing the $67 million held in Euros as payments towards signed Emission Reduction Purchase Agreements (ERPAs). To manage, maintain, and operate the Fund, the Bank would use the services of the Carbon Finance Unit currently assuming responsibiity for the management of other Bank-operated carbon funds. A designated Fund Manager and Fund Executive Coordinator will be responsible for the day-to-day management of the Fund, including overseeing the implementing partners ' activities,management of the Project Portfolio, overseeing the selection of projects, negotiation of relevant projec t agreements, and ensuring compliance with the Project Selection and Portfolio Criteria. Finances of the Fund will be used to purchase emission reductions on behalf of the public and private sector participants. Under the ERPAs, the Bank will purchase verified emission reductions, certified emission reductions, emission reduction units and assigned amount units,generated or transferred by a project."
